lines.text: Many learners say: I am searching about a new job.
Better: I am searching for a new job.
Use for when you try to find something.
For! She is searching for her keys.

data.wrong: I am searching about a new job.
data.right: I am searching for a new job.
data.why: Use for when you try to find something.

native.tip: نقول «أبحث عن وظيفة» بحرف عن، لكن نقول search for: “I am searching for a new job.” وليس “I am searching about a new job.”

en.tip: In Arabic we say «أبحث عن وظيفة» with «عن», but in English we say search for: “I am searching for a new job.” not “I am searching about a new job.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “I am searching about a new job.” 😅 In Arabic we say «أبحث عن وظيفة» with «عن», but in English we say search for, so the right sentence is “I am searching for a new job.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
